title: Kodak invented the thing that killed Kodak 📷
subject: camera
description:
Would you have bet against film in 1975? 👇

Kodak engineer Steve Sasson built the first digital camera in 1975. Kodak kept protecting its film business and filed for bankruptcy in 2012.

Sources: IEEE Spectrum ("The First Digital Camera"), PetaPixel (Sasson, 2010), Christian Science Monitor / AP (Kodak bankruptcy, Jan 19, 2012)

scenes.text: In 1975, Kodak built the camera that would destroy it.
Engineer Steve Sasson made the first digital camera. It weighed 8 pounds and took 23 seconds to save one photo to tape.
Executives saw no market. Kodak sold film, and this needed none.
Sasson couldn't show it outside the company.
But here's the strange part. Kodak later spent billions on digital, while still protecting film.
In 2012, Kodak went bankrupt, beaten by cameras like the one it built first. Because
